directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write a news report to your campus newspaper on a volunteer activity organized by your Student Union to assist elderly people in the neighborhood. You should write at least 120 words but no more than] 80 words.
sample_essay:
Recently, the Student Union organized a meaningful volunteer activity to assist the elderly in the neighborhood, which received enthusiastic participation from numerous students.

To begin with, upon arrival at the elderly's homes, students divided into different groups to carry out various tasks. Some students helped with housework, such as cleaning the rooms and doing the laundry. For example, they swept the floors and wiped the windows, making the living environment more comfortable for the elderly. In addition, other students accompanied the elderly, chatting with them and listening to their life stories. This interaction brought warmth and joy to the elderly, who often felt lonely.

In conclusion, this volunteer activity was a great success. It not only provided practical help to the elderly but also enhanced students' sense of social responsibility. It is hoped that more such activities will be organized in the future.
